answer_prose: After matching race edition, recorded gender and prior-time band, faster-opening runners finished 1.5% faster than their earlier benchmark on average; similar-opening runners finished 4.9% slower. Improved fitness could produce both a faster start and a faster finish, so this is not a recommendation to start aggressively.
detail_prose: The chart uses a benchmark from earlier years. It does not establish what would happen if an individual changed strategy.

charts.title: Performance after matching prior ability and race edition
charts.note: Negative is faster than the earlier benchmark. Intervals reflect uncertainty in group means, not the range of individual outcomes.
